from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
from math import floor


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily
            ).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=2)
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=4)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required = [self.symbols[ticker] for ticker in
                    ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]]

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        if self.spy_closes and aapl_close < self.aapl_closes[-1]:
            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
        elif self.spy_closes and aapl_close > self.aapl_closes[-1]:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)
        self.aapl_closes.append(aapl_close)

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            return

        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            quantity = floor(
                0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                quantity = floor(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma

from AlgorithmImports import *


class TwoSlotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.symbols["SPY"], 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.symbols["AAPL"], 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy = data.Bars[self.symbols["SPY"]]
        aapl = data.Bars[self.symbols["AAPL"]]

        if self.spy_previous_close is not None:
            if spy.Close > self.spy_previous_close:
                pass
            elif spy.Close < self.spy_previous_close:
                pass

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if aapl.Close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self.spy_previous_close = spy.Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl.Close
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self.spy_previous_close = spy.Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl.Close
            return

        current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        current_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
            and spy.Close < current_sma
        )

        aapl_sell_reason = (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and current_rsi > 60
        )

        if spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
            and spy.Close > current_sma
        )

        if spy_crosses_above:
            target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
            quantity = int(target_value / spy.Close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.Cash
            if available_cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.spy_previous_close = spy.Close
        self.spy_previous_sma = current_sma
        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl.Close

from AlgorithmImports import *
from math import floor
from collections import deque


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.spy_lot = 0

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
        self.RegisterIndicator(self.aapl, self.aapl_rsi, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        if not all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = float(data[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data[self.aapl].Close)

        self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

        spy_sma = None
        if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
            spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

        spy_sell = (
            self.spy_lot > 0
            and spy_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell = (
            self.aapl_lot > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60.0
        )

        if spy_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if aapl_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        spy_buy = (
            self.spy_lot == 0
            and spy_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        if spy_buy:
            shares = floor(
                (0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) / spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.spy_lot = shares

        aapl_red = (
            self.aapl_lot == 0
            and self.aapl_previous_close is not None
            and aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close
        )

        if aapl_red:
            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000.0:
                shares = floor(20000.0 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.aapl_lot = shares

        self.spy_previous_close = spy_close
        self.spy_previous_sma = spy_sma

        if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            return

        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        spy_crosses_below = (
            spy_sma_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None

            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

            rsi_ready and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

            if shares > 0:
